facts.fact: Wacker 穿着皮背心、软呢帽、青年布衬衫和紧身 Dockers 裤子走进会议室。
facts.anchor: He waddled into the conference room, dressed in a leather vest, fedora, chambray shirt, and Dockers as tight as sausage casings.

facts.fact: P. Richard Wacker 是他的真名，不是化名或假名。
facts.anchor: This was his true name, not a pseudonym or an alias.

facts.fact: Wacker 介绍 Andre B. KRAY 时点明这不是他的真名。
facts.anchor: Andre B. KRAY — not his true name —

facts.fact: KRAY 自述九年前加入机构，主要驻外，其间在 Hell 服役过。
facts.anchor: I joined the Agency a little over nine years ago, and I’ve served mainly overseas, including a stint in Hell.

facts.fact: 新政策要求今后只许用化名互相称呼。
facts.anchor: we have been asked to make a special effort to refer to each other henceforth in pseudonym only.

facts.fact: Wacker 亲自把新项目命名为「Project GOOWIKI」。
facts.anchor: which I have decided to christen ‘Project GOOWIKI.’

facts.fact: 就在这一刻 KRAY 说出了那两个小词。
facts.anchor: And that’s when KRAY said those two little words.

facts.fact: KRAY 自愿接手 BRAVESOUL 案以降低美国政府在当地的痕迹。
facts.anchor: KRAY had volunteered to take on the BRAVESOUL case to lower the USG footprint.
